title: CoMIC: Collaborative Memory and Insights Circulation for Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Web Cloud-Edge Systems
abstract: arXiv:2606.00756v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: LLM-based Web agents are increasingly deployed on edge servers to carry out long-horizon tasks on behalf of users with low latency. However, the lightweight models that fit on edge servers often struggle with long-horizon tasks that require persistent memory, subgoal tracking, and reflection. Fine-tuning edge models after deployment is costly and difficult to scale across heterogeneous nodes, while purely local execution confines each agent to its own isolated experience. We propose \textsc{CoMIC}, a parameter-update-free cloud-edge framework for Collaborative Memory and Insights Circulation. Following the paradigm of ``Act at the Edge, Reflect in the Cloud'', edge agents execute locally with subgoal-oriented hierarchical memory and selective re-expansion of relevant histories, while a cloud-side LLM critic asynchronously evaluates the trajectories uploaded through a Web gateway, admits reusable experience, and circulates cross-agent

translated_title: CoMIC：面向Web云边系统中长程LLM智能体的协同记忆与洞见循环
translated_abstract: 基于LLM的Web智能体越来越多地被部署在边缘服务器上，以低延迟的方式代表用户执行长程任务。然而，能够适配边缘服务器的轻量级模型在需要持久记忆、子目标跟踪和反思能力的长程任务中往往表现不佳。部署后对边缘模型进行微调成本高昂，且难以在异构节点之间扩展，而纯粹的本地执行又将每个智能体限制在自身孤立的经验之中。我们提出了CoMIC，一个无需参数更新的云边协同记忆与洞见循环框架。遵循“边缘执行，云端反思”的范式，边缘智能体通过面向子目标的分层记忆以及对相关历史的选择性重新扩展在本地执行任务，同时云端LLM批评者通过Web网关异步评估上传的轨迹，筛选出可复用的经验，并在智能体之间循环传递跨智能体的洞见。
tldr: CoMIC提出了一种无需参数更新的云边协同框架，通过“边缘执行、云端反思”范式，使边缘智能体借助分层记忆完成长程任务，云端LLM则异步评估轨迹并跨智能体循环共享可复用经验。
en_tdlr: CoMIC is a parameter-update-free cloud-edge framework where edge agents perform long-horizon tasks with subgoal-oriented hierarchical memory while a cloud-side LLM critic asynchronously evaluates trajectories and circulates reusable insights across agents, following the "Act at the Edge, Reflect in the Cloud" paradigm.
